about_the_game:
Explore the mysterious world in our roguelike game!

Are you ready to take on the challenge and face the dangers hidden in random dungeons? Our roguelike game offers an engaging, dramatic, and non-stop experience!

Features:

  • Random Dungeon Structure: Every time you start a new journey, the dungeon and levels will be randomly generated, bringing something new and unexpected. No two adventures are the same!

  • Permanent Death: Every decision has a vital meaning. When you fall, you will have to start all over again. Prepare yourself and do your best to survive and go further.

  • Turn-Based Progression: Fight enemies and explore turn-based dungeon chambers, requiring thorough tactics and calculations to overcome the challenges.

  • Bring a variety of challenges with powerful bosses.  

  • Variety of Items and Skills: Collect and upgrade a wide range of items, weapons, and skills to customize your character and create a unique fighting style.

Get ready to face unexpected challenges, immerse yourself in the paranormal world, and prove your mettle in this captivating roguelike game! Are you brave enough to overcome all odds and become the winner?
